trip_document_source_check.name: trip_document_source_check
trip_document_source_check.value: ("trip_document"."kind" = 'file' and "trip_document"."key" is not null) or ("trip_document"."kind" = 'link' and "trip_document"."url" is not null)

expense_original_check.name: expense_original_check
expense_original_check.value:
("expense"."original_currency" IS NULL AND "expense"."original_amount" IS NULL AND "expense"."exchange_rate" IS NULL AND "expense"."rate_source" IS NULL)
        OR ("expense"."original_currency" IS NOT NULL AND "expense"."original_amount" > 0 AND "expense"."exchange_rate" > 0 AND "expense"."rate_source" IS NOT NULL)
